label: extension

args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I found your group-bookings contact address mentioned in a guest review of City Hub Tokyo, and I am reaching out to inquire about a group stay.

I am organising a group trip to Tokyo and would like to ask about your availability for a group of 10 people during the month of June. Could you please let me know:

1. Whether you have availability for 10 guests in June, and which dates would be possible?
2. What room types or shared spaces you can offer for a group of this size?
3. Any group rates or discounts you may offer?

Please feel free to reply to this email or contact me directly using the details below.

Thank you very much for your time, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
args.subject: Group Booking Inquiry - Availability for 10 People in June
